This plot is small and rented, so I will not put too much cash into it. I usually save my money for the plots I control better, and on this one I will use the cassava stems I can get locally, not expensive improved ones. I will use some compost or old manure if I can gather it nearby, clear weeds mostly by hand, and I will not wait for irrigation because I depend on the rains here.
